_comment: Symmetric kernels exist only for AllReduce, AllGather, and ReduceScatter,
so the symmetric suite runs those three at -R 2. LSA all_reduce_perf
(-D 1/-D 2) stays here: all_reduce_perf does not build under ENABLE_ROCSHMEM_GIN.
device-api.sbatch runs this matrix first, then device-api-tests.json against
the cmake ENABLE_ROCSHMEM_GIN build. Launch path is ${RCCL_TESTS_BIN_DIR}/<bin>
bench_args: common bench flags | base_env: -x on every run
{LOGDIR} in debug_env is replaced by the runner with the per-job debug dir,
so NCCL_DEBUG_FILE writes per-rank logs there instead of flooding stdout.
